title: fd6: receiveTypingIndicators in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md
description:
Add receiveTypingIndicators to draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md in four locations.

What: Add the field and wire the suppression check into the main spec.

Algorithm:
1. In Chat object fields section (after messageExpirySeconds field): add
   'receiveTypingIndicators (Boolean): When false, the server silently drops typing push events for this chat before delivery to the owner. The sender is not informed. Default: true. Owner-side preference; not shared with peers.'
2. In Chat/set Updating a Chat section: add receiveTypingIndicators to the patch keys list alongside muted, muteUntil, pinnedMessageIds, messageExpirySeconds.
3. In Chat/typing Server Behavior paragraph: after 'The server MUST NOT persist this event.' add a new sentence: 'Before delivering a typing push event to the owner of a Chat, the server MUST check the Chat receiveTypingIndicators field; if it is false, the server MUST silently drop the event and MUST NOT deliver it to any of that owner connected clients.'
4. In Security Considerations near Blocked Contacts: add a brief paragraph explaining that receiveTypingIndicators suppression is server-side and sender-unaware (Chat/typing returns success regardless).

Defensive rules: No new methods, no new types. All changes are additions or small modifications to existing prose. Normative strength: MUST for the suppression check (MUST-1), MUST for sender non-exposure (MUST-2), default true (MUST-5). The field description uses same wording pattern as muted field.
acceptance_criteria: All four locations in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md updated. receiveTypingIndicators field present in Chat object fields. Patch key present in Chat/set. Suppression MUST present in Chat/typing. Security note present.
